scored_opportunities.name: Custom Spec Extractor
scored_opportunities.what_the_agent_does: Parses incoming customer emails and web forms to extract trailer dimensions, materials, and accessories, populating a draft order form for human review.
scored_opportunities.gap: Manual data entry from varied customer communications into the ERP system.
scored_opportunities.rating_reason: Directly addresses complex customization intake pain points; moderate effort is offset by low risk due to human-in-the-loop confirmation, aligning with safe rollout practices.

scored_opportunities.name: Dynamic Quote Calculator Assistant
scored_opportunities.what_the_agent_does: Pulls real-time material costs and labor rates to generate preliminary price estimates based on extracted order specifications.
scored_opportunities.gap: Manual calculation of pricing based on fluctuating material costs and custom configurations.
scored_opportunities.rating_reason: Speeds up the time-consuming quoting cycle; effort is moderate due to ERP pricing sync, but risk is controlled by requiring human approval before sending quotes.

scored_opportunities.name: Material Availability Scheduler
scored_opportunities.what_the_agent_does: Checks live inventory levels for steel, aluminum, and components against pending orders to suggest feasible production start dates.
scored_opportunities.gap: Manual cross-referencing of inventory spreadsheets with order backlogs to avoid delays.
scored_opportunities.rating_reason: Tackles material availability bottlenecks; risk is minimal because it uses read-only ERP access and only provides suggestions for human schedulers to finalize.

scored_opportunities.name: QC Checklist Generator & Tracker
scored_opportunities.what_the_agent_does: Generates model-specific quality inspection checklists based on order custom options and tracks inspector completion status.
scored_opportunities.gap: Manual creation of inspection checklists for each unique trailer configuration.
scored_opportunities.rating_reason: High value for ensuring consistency across different models; moderate effort to map options to checklists, with manageable risk since it supports rather than replaces human inspectors.

scored_opportunities.name: Warranty & Status Inquiry Bot
scored_opportunities.what_the_agent_does: Answers customer questions about order status, warranty coverage, and maintenance tips using production schedules and policy documents.
scored_opportunities.gap: Manual lookup of order status and warranty terms for every customer call or email.
scored_opportunities.rating_reason: Directly matches the best practice for status inquiries; high value from reduced support volume, low effort due to existing data sources, and minimal risk with read-only access.

scored_opportunities.name: Unstructured Order Data Cleaner
scored_opportunities.what_the_agent_does: Standardizes incoming customer specifications (dimensions, materials, accessories) into a structured format for downstream systems.
scored_opportunities.gap: Inconsistent formatting in customer requests causing rework and data entry errors.
scored_opportunities.rating_reason: True enabler that solves the root cause of intake inefficiencies; high value and low risk justify moderate effort as a foundational pilot for all other agents.
